Arnhold Education Opportunity - Transforming Education at the Last Mile
==
When children miss years of schooling, they may be at risk of increased violence and exploitation, and may experience long-term negative effects on their health, education and economic prosperity. Worse, the longer children are out of school, the less likely they are to return. The International Rescue Committee (IRC)’s Airbel Impact Lab will help mitigate the global education crisis — significantly exacerbated by the COVID-19 pandemic — through innovative programming in Bangladesh, Colombia, and Nigeria that provides proven effective, technology-enabled education solutions to out-of-school children in humanitarian contexts, while supporting parents and caregivers to help kids transition back to formal education and achieve critical learning milestones.
